priors.note: Manual context prior: elite pound-for-pound status and opponent quality keep low-volume striking from being treated as low-skill striking.

manualContext.question: Could JDM keep the fight in boxing minutes, or would Islam's wrestling convert welterweight size into control?
manualContext.modelCaveat: This is a route-comparison backtest. It compares pre-fight tendencies to the actual fight shape and separates tendency from confidence.
manualContext.keyRead: The pre-fight model was directionally right on Islam's control route and too generous to JDM's striking-volume path once takedown threat changed the exchanges.
